events.title: 아스널 keep their hopes of qualifying for the UEFA Cup alive by beating 맨체스터 유나이티드 3–0 at Highbury. FA Cup finalists Brighton slide closer to relegation after only being able to manage a 1–1 draw at Birmingham, a result which lifts the hosts out of the relegation zone at the expense of 맨체스터 시티. QPR clinch the Second Division title with a 3–1 home win over West London rivals 풀럼, which promotes 울버햄프턴 원더러스 (who draw 3–3 with 찰턴 애슬레틱 at The Valley ) and allows 레스터 시티 to go third on goal difference despite only being able to manage a 2–2 draw on their visit to 리즈 유나이티드. 포츠머스 miss the chance to seal promotion from the Third Division when Orient hold them to a 2–2 draw at Fratton Park .
카디프 시티's promotion from the Third Division is delayed by a 3–0 defeat to 질링엄 at Priestfield .
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 keep their Second Division promotion push alive with a 5–0 win over 반즐리 at Oakwell .
포트 베일 win promotion from the Fourth Division with a 2–0 win over 스톡포트 카운티 at Edgeley Park .

FA Cup finalists Brighton are relegated from the First Division with a 1–0 defeat to 맨체스터 시티 in the relegation crunch game at the Goldstone Ground. 스완지 시티's 2–1 defeat at 맨체스터 유나이티드 also sends them down, just one season after finishing sixth in the First Division. 버밍엄 시티 stay clear of the bottom three with a 2–0 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼. 코번트리 시티 arrest their alarming slide down the table and stay clear of the bottom three with a 3–0 win at Stoke. 포츠머스, 카디프 시티 and 허더즈필드 타운 all seal promotion to the Second Division, with Huddersfield seeing off their last remaining promotion rivals 뉴포트 카운티 1–0 at Leeds Road .
밀월 move closer to securing a remarkable escape from relegation in the Third Division by beating their London rivals 브렌트퍼드 1–0 at The Den .

루턴 타운 miss the chance to climb out of the bottom three when they lose their penultimate First Division game 3–0 to 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Old Trafford, meaning that they will need to win their final game of the season when they return to Manchester to face City at Maine Road.
Scottish club Aberdeen win the European Cup Winners' Cup by beating 레알 마드리드 2–1 in the Ullevi Stadium , Gothenburg .
맨체스터 유나이티드 miss the chance to clinch runners-up spot in the First Division when they lose 2–0 at 토트넘 홋스퍼.

The First Division season ends with 왓퍼드 beating 리버풀 2–1 to finish runners-up in their first season as a First Division team. 맨체스터 유나이티드 finish third after losing 3–2 away to 노츠 카운티. 토트넘 홋스퍼 book another European campaign, this time in the UEFA Cup , with a 4–1 home win over 스토크 시티 ensuring a fourth-place finish for Keith Burkinshaw 's team. 노팅엄 포리스트 seal a return to European competitions after missing out last season by beating doomed Swansea 3–0 at the Vetch Field to fifth. The final UEFA Cup place goes to 애스턴 빌라, who beat 아스널 2–1 at Villa Park to finish sixth. 루턴 타운 pull off a remarkable escape from relegation when a late goal from Yugoslav defender Radomir Antic gives them a 1–0 away win over 맨체스터 시티 and sends the hosts down after 17 years in the First Division. 레스터 시티 seal the final promotion place in the Second Division, drawing 0–0 at home to 번리 while 풀럼 lose 1–0 at 더비 카운티 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 draw 2–2 at 울버햄프턴 원더러스. 볼턴 원더러스 are relegated from the Second Division after going down 4–1 at 찰턴 애슬레틱 in their final game of the season, as are 로더럼 유나이티드 after being held to a 2–2 draw by 리즈 유나이티드 at Elland Road . The final remaining game of the Second Division is a relegation decider between 번리 and 크리스털 팰리스 which has yet to be played. Reading and 렉섬 join 동커스터 로버스 in relegation from the Third Division. 스컨소프 유나이티드 pip Bury to the final promotion place in the Fourth Division with a 2–1 win over 체스터 시티 at Sealand Road , with the Gigg Lane side missing out on promotion after losing 3–1 at home to champions 윔블던.

The Football League season draws to a close with the Second Division relegation decider at Selhurst Park and a dead-rubber match at Feethams . In the Selhurst Park clash, 크리스털 팰리스 beat 번리 1–0 to send their Lancastrian opponents down to the Third Division at the end of a season where two good cup runs took their strain on a side which couldn't repeat the same form in the league. The Fourth Division clash between 달링턴 and 피터버러 유나이티드 is a seven-goal thriller with the home side winning 4–3.
에버턴 sell 21-year-old winger Steve McMahon , 21, to 애스턴 빌라 for £175,000.

맨체스터 유나이티드 and Brighton & Hove Albion draw 2–2 in the FA Cup final to book a replay in five days time. Brighton nearly win the game with a late shot by Gordon Smith , which United goalkeeper Gary Bailey saves.
German club 함부르크 defeats Italian champions 유벤투스 1–0 at the Olympic Stadium in Athens to win the European Cup .

맨체스터 유나이티드 thrash Brighton & Hove Albion 4–0 in the FA Cup final replay to lift the trophy on legendary former manager and current director Sir 맷 버스비's 74th birthday. Bryan Robson scores twice, with Norman Whiteside becoming the youngest scorer in an FA Cup final shortly after his 18th birthday, while an Arnold Muhren penalty makes the Dutchman one of the first foreign players to score in an English cup final.
코번트리 시티 sack manager Dave Sexton after two seasons in charge. His successor is the 브리스틀 로버스 manager and former Sky Blues player Bobby Gould .
